title: Normalized ordinary and derived scalar tensor balancing
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme and $a:R\to S$ a morphism of commutative ring sheaves on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the actual universal derived scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] and chosen tensor models with their flat-term K-flat representative identifications [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The ordinary scalar/tensor isomorphism sends $s\otimes(m\otimes n)$ to $(s\otimes m)\otimes(1\otimes n)$, naturally in both modules. Define scalarTensorTotal to be the signed total comparison from the tensor of the two extended complexes to the extension of their tensor total; it is invertible. Define scalarTensor to be the unique natural derived balancing isomorphism from scalar extension after the source tensor to target tensor after the two scalar extensions. On every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes, its composite with the two universal scalar counits, after the source representative identification, equals the tensor-complex scalar counit followed by the localization of the inverse scalarTensorTotal and then the target representative identification. No flatness of $a$ is assumed. The canonical coefficient-site smallness and sheafification instances and the actual tensor-model existence theorem are included in this construction.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EL and 06YY. Relocation of the tensor part of def-sf-compact-support-scalar-tensor-identification without changing definitions or signatures.

proof.text: Construct the native tensor model and ordinary scalar comparison, then form the signed total of inverse ordinary comparisons. Descend this comparison through K-flat representatives and derived localization; this supplies an isomorphism satisfying the displayed flat-pair normalization.
Use the separately stated existence and uniqueness parts of the normalized derived descent obligation to assemble the unique comparison and select it as scalarTensor.

proof_origin.note: Ordinary comparison and total isomorphism are proved in the item. The former derived scalarTensor_existsUnique obligation is decomposed into separately named existence and uniqueness statements; scalarTensor combines them by real Lean proof.

def scalarTensor {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    (r : ProEtaleTensorModel W R) (s : ProEtaleTensorModel W S) :
    r.tensor ⋙ pbcDerivedExtend a ≅
      ((pbcDerivedExtend a).prod (pbcDerivedExtend a)) ⋙ s.tensor
